model.strand_handling: pinned upstream variant forward, mean of forward and reverse-complement head probabilities

score.experimental_effect_conversion: E=ALT,O=REF keep raw effect; E=REF,O=ALT negate once; all other/unknown pairs reject or pending; do not assume numbered alleles are REF

metrics.denominators: all submitted, validated, rejected, pending and inferred cases reported separately
metrics.sign_agreement_definition: Primary: equality of mathematical sign(score) and sign(normalized experimental effect), including exact zeros; no posthoc tolerance. Denominator = finite scored cases with known finite effects.
metrics.secondary_sign_agreement: Exclude exact-zero experimental effects only; predicted zero versus nonzero effect counts as disagreement. Record both zero counts and denominators.
metrics.uncertainty: When primary source provides confidence intervals or standard errors, preserve them and count intervals containing zero separately; never invent them or exclude uncertain effects from primary metrics after observing predictions.
metrics.undefined_spearman: Return null with explicit reason for fewer than two pairs or a constant ranked vector; ties use average ranks.

acceptance.adapter: all ten cases accounted; complete verified windows, allele/strand agreement, finite strict FP32 head outputs and repeat checks within limits
acceptance.evaluation: predefined hundred biological cases and disjoint split; report every outcome and descriptive association with measured effects, including negative findings
acceptance.instrumentation_control: implementation/input/model-path checks only; biological feasibility remains pending

scope: Frozen head/context/score configuration before biological predictions; exact dataset acquisition/schema/selection/effect semantics still required. No biological cases have been evaluated.

selection.eligibility: freeze the actual source-to-normalized schema, source filters, effect orientation and permitted usage before predictions; technical SNV/input eligibility only, no score-based or outcome-based choices
selection.rank_key: SHA256 UTF-8 seed + newline + genome_build + newline + chrom + newline + decimal position_1based + newline + ref + newline + alt + newline + origin_row_id
selection.order: ascending rank_key, then canonical case_id; reject duplicate case IDs and loci in the normalized pool with a recorded reason
selection.independence: greedily admit only complete [q-2048,q+2048) windows disjoint from all earlier admitted windows on that chromosome; q=position_1based-1
selection.allocation: first10 admitted loci form adapter; next100 form evaluation; freeze all110 before any predictions
selection.invalid_after_freeze: count and retain invalid/unavailable loci in their original slots; never replace them to improve the outcome
